data.one_liner: Flutter widget providing the Android 13 squiggly seekbar for media players.
data.what_it_does: Provides a drop-in replacement for the standard Flutter Slider widget that renders a animated squiggly line track similar to the Android 13 media player seekbar. It includes customizable properties to control the squiggle amplitude, wavelength, speed, and thumb design.
use_when: You want to replicate the Android 13 media player squiggly slider design in your Flutter app.
You need a custom slider widget with animated squiggly tracks.
avoid_when: Your app has not migrated to package:material_ui and you are using version 2.0.0+.
You require standard platform-native sliders without custom squiggly effects.
strengths: Drop-in replacement for the standard Slider widget
Customizable squiggle amplitude, wavelength, and speed
Supports line thumb design matching Android 13 media controls
weaknesses: Only the left-hand side of the track can be squiggly in the current version
Requires migration to package:material_ui in version 2.0.0
data.setup_notes: Requires running dart fix or migrating to package:material_ui for version 2.0.0+.
